title: Cover — IBM × Horizon AI Transformation Response
description: Title slide introducing the deck: IBM AMS responding to 6 leadership questions from Horizon BCBS on AI transformation.

title: Q1 — AI Productivity & Proposed Tool Stack
description: Section divider for Question 1: How will AI drive productivity, and which tools is IBM proposing for Horizon?

title: Q1 — How AI Drives Productivity
description: Three productivity pillars — Automate (watsonx Orchestrate), Augment (watsonx.ai), Accelerate (watsonx Code Assistant).

title: Q1 — Proposed AI Tool Stack
description: Six proposed tools: watsonx.ai, watsonx Code Assistant, watsonx Orchestrate, IBM AIOps, IBM Process Mining, CareOps360.

title: Q2 — Team Structure in a Project-Funded Model
description: Section divider for Question 2: How would IBM structure delivery teams given Horizon's project-based funding model?

title: Q2 — From Project Funding to Product Pods
description: Three-phase team evolution: Today (project silos) → 6 Months (hybrid pod model) → 18 Months+ (product-funded steady state).

title: Q3 — Horizon's AI Adoption Journey
description: Section divider for Question 3: What are the steps of Horizon's evolution as the team adopts AI in delivery over time?

title: Q3 — Three-Horizon Evolution
description: Foundation (Now–12m), Scale (12–24m), and Operate (24m+) phases with specific initiatives per phase.

title: Q4 — Data Readiness & AI Agent Requirements
description: Section divider for Question 4: IBM's assessment of Horizon's current data and what is needed to enable AI agents.

title: Q4 — Current State & Enablement Path
description: Two-column view: current data strengths and gaps on the left; IBM's data access, governance, and infrastructure requirements on the right.

title: Q5 — Transformation Priorities & Pod Alignment
description: Section divider for Question 5: Which efforts should Horizon prioritise first and how do they connect to the pod model?

title: Q5 — Sequenced Priority Model
description: Three sequenced priorities: 01 AIOps & Operational Visibility → 02 POD Operating Model → 03 AI Use Cases (PA & Member).

title: Q6 — Transition Plan: 30 / 60 / 90 Days
description: Section divider for Question 6: A detailed walkthrough of the transition and what Horizon should expect at each milestone.

title: Q6 — Milestone Expectations
description: Four-column milestone grid: Day 30, Day 60, Day 90, and 6 Months+ — each with four specific deliverables.

title: Closing — Operational Excellence Through AI
description: IBM's commitment statement to Horizon BCBS, next steps, and CareOps360 access details.
